spells.name: Flash
spells.brief: Blink a short distance in target direction.
spells.full: Teleport a short distance in the target direction. THE most important spell — taken by 99% of champions. Used for engage (Flash+R combos), escape, dodging skillshots, repositioning. 150 second cooldown means tracking enemy Flash is critical.
spells.embedding_text: Flash is a summoner spell in Wild Rift. Cooldown: 150s. Blink a short distance in target direction. Teleport a short distance in the target direction. THE most important spell — taken by 99% of champions. Used for engage (Flash+R combos), escape, dodging skillshots, repositioning. 150 second cooldown means tracking enemy Flash is critical. Best for: all champions. Tags: blink, mobility, engage, escape, universal.

graph_edges.context: Nimbus Cloak grants MS burst after Flash
Flash+R unavoidable AoE knockup
Flash+Tibbers instant AoE stun
Flash+R AoE stun in team fights

power_spikes.description: Flash enables Flash+R combos, escapes, repositioning. Track enemy Flash CD (150s).

early.action: Save Flash for escaping ganks or securing First Blood.

mid.action: Use Flash for Flash+R engages on grouped enemies.

late.action: Flash is game-deciding. One Flash+R can win a team fight.

spells.name: Ignite
spells.full: Deal 60 true damage over 5 seconds to target enemy champion and apply 50% Grievous Wounds (reduces all healing received by 50%). Best for kill lanes, assassins, aggressive supports. Secures kills on low-HP targets and cuts enemy healing.
spells.embedding_text: Ignite is a summoner spell in Wild Rift. Cooldown: 90s. 60 true damage over 5s + 50% Grievous Wounds. Deal 60 true damage over 5 seconds to target enemy champion and apply 50% Grievous Wounds (reduces all healing received by 50%). Best for kill lanes, assassins, aggressive supports. Secures kills on low-HP targets and cuts enemy healing. Best for: assassins, aggressive supports, baron lane fighters. Tags: true_damage, dot, grievous_wounds, anti_heal, kill_pressure, aggressive.

graph_edges.context: Ignite + Electrocute burst secures early kills

GW reduces Aatrox drain-tank sustain

power_spikes.description: Ignite provides kill threat from level 1.

early.action: Use Ignite during all-ins to secure kills.

mid.action: Save for high-value targets with healing.

late.action: Use on priority target during team fight.

spells.name: Heal
spells.brief: Restore 80-360 HP + 30% bonus MS for 1s to you and nearest ally.
spells.full: Restore 80-360 HP (scales with level) to yourself and the nearest wounded allied champion. Also grants both of you 30% bonus movement speed for 1 second. Standard ADC spell. Note: Heal has reduced effect on allies recently healed by another Heal — don't stack two Heals in bot lane.

mid.action: Use during Dragon fights or 2v2 skirmishes.

late.action: Heal during team fights for emergency HP.

spells.name: Exhaust
spells.brief: Reduce target's MS by 20% + damage dealt by 40% for 2.5s.
spells.full: Reduce target enemy champion's movement speed by 20% and damage dealt by 40% for 2.5 seconds. THE anti-carry spell. Shuts down enemy assassins, ADCs, and divers. Best on supports vs dive/assassin comps.

Best on supports vs dive/assassin comps. Best for: supports, vs assassins, vs divers. Tags: slow, damage_reduction, anti_carry, peel, support, defensive.

late.action: Exhaust the biggest threat to your carry.

spells.name: Barrier
spells.full: Gain a shield that absorbs 115-465 damage (scales with level) for 2 seconds. Shorter cooldown than Heal (90s vs 120s) and bigger personal shield. Best for mid laners vs burst where you only need to protect yourself.

spells.name: Ghost
spells.brief: Large burst of MS decaying to 25% bonus for 6s.
spells.full: Gain a large burst of movement speed that decays to 25% bonus movement speed over 6 seconds. Also grants the ability to pass through units (no creep block). Best for champions who need to stick to targets or kite.

spells.name: Smite
spells.brief: 440-1000 true damage to monster/minion. Heals 70 HP. Mandatory for junglers.
spells.full: Deal 440-1000 true damage (scales with level) to a large or epic monster or minion. Heals 70 HP on cast. Upgrades to Chilling Smite (slow enemy champion) or Challenging Smite (damage reduction) after killing 4 large monsters. MANDATORY for junglers — required for jungle item upgrades and objective securing.

spells.name: Teleport
spells.brief: Channel 3s then blink to target allied champion, ward, or turret (turrets only before 6:00).
spells.full: Active: After channeling for 3 seconds, remove any homestart or homeguard buff and blink to the target allied champion or ward. Your destination will be visibly marked to enemies. Passive (0-6:00 elapsed): You can also target allied turrets. Cooldown: 150 seconds. Best for baron laners who split-push then join team fights. Provides global map pressure.

mid.action: Split-push a side lane, then TP to team when fight breaks out.

late.action: TP is game-deciding. Split to draw pressure, TP to Baron/Dragon fights.
